title: Continuity of shifted Hom along a specified cocone
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be a pretriangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] whose Hom groups
are in a fixed universe, let $I$ be a small category, and let $D:I\to\mathcal T$ be a diagram
with cocone $c$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Define $H(D,c)(K)$ for $K\in\mathcal T$ to mean
that for every integer $n$ the map
$\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}(K,D_i[n])\to\operatorname{Hom}(K,c_\infty[n])$
induced by the shifted cocone legs is an isomorphism of abelian groups. No colimit of $D$
in $\mathcal T$ is assumed; the displayed colimit is taken in abelian groups.
